product_summary: Website (proecenergy.com, product pages read 2026) shows five real product lines: (1) Oil-based mud additives — organoclay PEL-OCLAY / PEL-OCLAY HT, liquid viscosifier VISCOMOD P, primary/secondary emulsifiers PEL MUL P/S/O, wetting agent PEL WET, thinner PEL-THIN, organophilic lignite PEL-OLIG, asphalt PEL-TROL M, polymeric fluid-loss additive PEL-FIL R; (2) Water-based mud additives — xanthan gum blend PEL-VIS-XG, sulphonated/natural asphalt, polyamine and glycol shale inhibitors, PHPA, modified (pre-gelatinised) starch PEL STARCH PG/HT, lignite, PAC LV, defoamers, ester lubricants, biocide AD 100, oxygen scavengers, LCM (graphite, cellulose fibre, nut plug, mica, calcium carbonate), imidazoline corrosion inhibitor; (3) Completion & cementing additives — Glidecarb organophilic calcium carbonate, C-DFM defoamer, C-SP/C-SP PLUS spacers, C-FLA fluid-loss additive; (4) Commodity chemicals — zinc oxide, zinc carbonate, lime, soda ash, caustic soda, caustic potash, sodium bicarbonate, calcium chloride, magnesium oxide, potassium chloride, sodium chloride, citric acid, guar gum, SAPP, cotton seed hulls, pipe lax, calcium carbonate, formic acid; (5) Agro chemicals — a long list of formulated herbicides/insecticides/fungicides (glyphosate 41% SL, pendimethalin 30% EC, azoxystrobin+tebuconazole SC, paraquat 24% SL, bifenthrin EC, thiamethoxam combos, atrazine WP, mancozeb WP, carbendazim WP, fipronil GR, etc.).
comment: Declared single code 382499 is only PARTIALLY correct: it plausibly covers the core oilfield chemical preparations (organoclay, emulsifiers, thinners, fluid-loss additives, shale inhibitors, lubricants, defoamers, corrosion inhibitors, spacers) — these are the company's own branded, manufactured lines and fit 3824 99 90. However the declaration is far too narrow for the actual catalogue: (a) commodity chemicals are individually classified (soda ash 2836.20, caustic soda 2815.11, caustic potash 2815.20, sodium bicarbonate 2836.30, calcium chloride 2827.20, MgO 2519.90, KCl 3104.20, NaCl 2501.00, citric acid 2918.14, formic acid 2915.11, guar gum 1302.32, SAPP 2835.25, lime 2522.10, calcium carbonate 2836.50) and cannot be shipped under 3824 99; (b) the agrochemical line is a completely different chapter (3808) and is missing from the declaration entirely; (c) drilling starch (3505), PAC/CMC (3912.31) and xanthan/polymers (3913.90) are also outside 3824. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is broadly right for the oilfield/commodity side but omits the agrochemical segment, so the industry classification is incomplete rather than wrong. Trader signs: the site self-describes as both 'manufacturers' and 'suppliers' and lists third-party-style commodity and agro items alongside own brands, so a manufacturer_trader role is the honest reading; no customs line was available to me in this task, therefore every product-to-HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the product list is corroborated only by the company's own website, not by a shipment record. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: company retained, declared code corrected/expanded to the actual product mix, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
